              "CRP --> Xpert Ultra",
              "LAM --> Xpert Ultra",
              "CAD-CXR | CRP | LAM --> Xpert Ultra",
              "CAD-CXR | LAM --> Xpert Ultra",
              "CRP | LAM --> Xpert Ultra",
              "CAD-CXR | CRP --> Xpert Ultra",
              "CAD-CXR --> LAM",
              "CRP --> LAM",
              "CAD-CXR | CRP --> LAM"
)

settings<-paste(sep="_",dfResPrimBayesHIV$country,dfResPrimBayesHIV$region,dfResPrimBayesHIV$setting)
settings<-settings[grepl(pattern="PHC",settings)]
settings<-settings[c(length(settings),1:(length(settings)-1))]

gr<-expand.grid(settings,algoNames)

dfAlgos<-data.frame(
  setting=gr[,1],
  algo=gr[,2],
  label=algoLabels[match(gr[,2],algoNames)],
  prev=NA,
  prevAS=NA,
  sens=NA,
  spec=NA,
  ppv=NA,
  npv=NA,
  dyt=NA,
  lrp=NA,
  lrm=NA
)

for(j in 1:nrow(dfAlgos)){
  res<-allResHIV[[as.character(dfAlgos$setting[j])]]
  par<-dfAlgos$algo[j]
  
  # TB prevalence
  pointEstimate<-gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",res$mcmcSummary["ptb","mean"])
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary["ptb",c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")
  dfAlgos$prev[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
  
  # TB prevalence in asymptomatics
  tmp<-unlist(strsplit(split="_",as.character(dfAlgos$setting[j])))
  if(tmp[1]!="Aggregate"){
    dfTmp<-dfSim %>% filter(country==tmp[1] & region==tmp[2] & setting==tmp[3])
  }else{
    dfTmp<-dfSim %>% filter(setting==tmp[3])
  }
  k<-sum(!dfTmp$w4ss)
  n<-nrow(dfTmp)
  pointEstimate<-round(digits=4,k/n)
  ci<-round(digits=4,binom.test(x=k,n=n)$conf.int)
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",ci)),")")
  dfAlgos$prevAS[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
  
  # sensitivity
  pointEstimate<-gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","pse.",par),"mean"])
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","pse.",par),c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")
  dfAlgos$sens[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
  
  # specificity
  pointEstimate<-gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","psp.",par),"mean"])
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","psp.",par),c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")
  dfAlgos$spec[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
  
  # PPV
  pointEstimate<-gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","ppv.",par),"mean"])
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","ppv.",par),c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")
  dfAlgos$ppv[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
  
  # NPV
  pointEstimate<-gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","npv.",par),"mean"])
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","npv.",par),c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")
  dfAlgos$npv[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
  
  # DYT
  pointEstimate<-gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","dyt.",par),"mean"])
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","dyt.",par),c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")
  dfAlgos$dyt[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
  
  # LR+
  pointEstimate<-gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","lrp.",par),"mean"])
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","lrp.",par),c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")
  dfAlgos$lrp[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
  
  # LR-
  pointEstimate<-gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","lrm.",par),"mean"])
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","lrm.",par),c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")
  dfAlgos$lrm[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
}

dfAlgos$setting<-gsub(pattern="_+",replacement=" ",dfAlgos$setting)

colnames(dfAlgos)<-case_when(
  colnames(dfAlgos)=="setting"~"Country & setting",
  colnames(dfAlgos)=="algo"~"Algorithm code",
  colnames(dfAlgos)=="label"~"Algorithm",
  colnames(dfAlgos)=="prev"~"TB prevalence",
  colnames(dfAlgos)=="prevAS"~"Asymptomatic TB prevalence",
  colnames(dfAlgos)=="sens"~"Sensitivity",
  colnames(dfAlgos)=="spec"~"Specificity",
  colnames(dfAlgos)=="ppv"~"PPV",
  colnames(dfAlgos)=="npv"~"NPV",
  colnames(dfAlgos)=="dyt"~"DYT",
  colnames(dfAlgos)=="dyd"~"DYD",
  colnames(dfAlgos)=="lrp"~"Positive LR",
  colnames(dfAlgos)=="lrm"~"Negative LR"
)

dfAlgos %>%
  dplyr::select(!contains("code") & !contains("DYD") & !contains("Algorithm")) %>%
  kable(caption="Facility-based case finding evaluation of algorithms for PHC / lowest levels of primary care settings PLHIV only). Asymptomatics (i.e. those screening negative for W4SS) proportions are estimated directly, using exact binomial confidence intervals, from the data (not modelled). All other parameters are posterior estimates from the Bayesian modelling approach.") %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling(full_width = FALSE) %>%
  kableExtra::group_rows(index=table(fct_inorder(dfAlgos$Algorithm)),label_row_css = "text-align: left")
```

dt$specCI[dt$specCI=="NA"]<-""

                   ci_col = c("steelblue"),

                   vertline_lty = c("dashed", "dashed"),
                   vertline_col = c("darkred","orange"),
                   # Table cell padding, width 4 and heights 3
                   core = list(padding = unit(c(4, 3), "mm")))

p <- forest(dt[,c("Setting","sensCI","Sensitivity","specCI","Specificity")],
            est = list(dt$sensEst,dt$specEst),
            lower = list(dt$sensLow,dt$specLow),
            upper = list(dt$sensHigh,dt$specHigh),
            ci_column = c(3, 5),
            ref_line = 1,
            vert_line = list(c(0.75,0.85),c(0.90,0.95)),
            nudge_y = 0,
            theme = tm,
            xlim=c(0,1),
            footnote="The dashed lines indicate minimum (red) and optimum (orange) thresholds.")

plot(p)

pdf(paste(sep="",outPrefix,"forestPlot_PcfIcfPHC_",gsub(pattern="-",replacement="",Sys.Date()),".pdf"),width=11,height=30)
plot(p)
dev.off()

    names(dt)<-c("Algorithm","sensCI","sensEst","sensLow","sensHigh","Sensitivity","specCI","specEst","specLow","specHigh","Specificity")
  }else{
    dt<-rbind(dt,c(uniqueAlgos[i],res))
  }
}

dt$sensLow<-as.double(dt$sensLow)
dt$sensHigh<-as.double(dt$sensHigh)
dt$specEst<-as.double(dt$specEst)
dt$specLow<-as.double(dt$specLow)
dt$specHigh<-as.double(dt$specHigh)

dt$specCI[dt$specCI=="NA"]<-""

# Set-up theme

                   ci_pch = c(15),
                   ci_col = c("steelblue"),
                   footnote_gp = gpar(col = "darkgreen",fontsize=8),

                   vertline_col = c("darkred","orange"),

p <- forest(dt[,c("Algorithm","sensCI","Sensitivity","specCI","Specificity")],
            est = list(dt$sensEst,dt$specEst),
            lower = list(dt$sensLow,dt$specLow),
            upper = list(dt$sensHigh,dt$specHigh),
            ci_column = c(3, 5),
            ref_line = 1,
            vert_line = list(c(0.75,0.85),c(0.90,0.95)),

            xlim=c(0,1),

pdf(paste(sep="",outPrefix,"forestPlot_PcfIcfPHC_TopAlgosOnly_AggregateOnly_",gsub(pattern="-",replacement="",Sys.Date()),".pdf"),width=11,height=3)
plot(p)
dev.off()
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-indivAssays_primAnalHIVPcfIcf
#| tbl-cap: "Facility-based case finding evaluation of individual assays (PLHIV only): Bayesian posterior estimates for sensitivity, specificity, positive and negative predictive values and positive and negative likelihood ratios for PHC / lowest level of primary care settings."

             "Crp",

gr<-expand.grid(settings,algoNames)

  setting=gr[,1],
  algo=gr[,2],

  prev=NA,
  prevAS=NA,
  sens=NA,
  spec=NA,
  ppv=NA,
  npv=NA,
  dyt=NA,
  lrp=NA,
  lrm=NA
)

for(j in 1:nrow(dfAlgos)){
  res<-allResHIV[[as.character(dfAlgos$setting[j])]]
  par<-dfAlgos$algo[j]
  
  # TB prevalence
  pointEstimate<-gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",res$mcmcSummary["ptb","mean"])
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary["ptb",c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")
  dfAlgos$prev[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
  
  # TB prevalence in asymptomatics
  tmp<-unlist(strsplit(split="_",as.character(dfAlgos$setting[j])))
  if(tmp[1]!="Aggregate"){
    dfTmp<-dfSim %>% filter(country==tmp[1] & region==tmp[2] & setting==tmp[3])
  }else{
    dfTmp<-dfSim %>% filter(setting==tmp[3])
  }
  k<-sum(!dfTmp$w4ss)
  n<-nrow(dfTmp)
  pointEstimate<-round(digits=4,k/n)
  ci<-round(digits=4,binom.test(x=k,n=n)$conf.int)
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",ci)),")")
  dfAlgos$prevAS[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
  
  # sensitivity
  pointEstimate<-gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","pse.",par),"mean"])
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","pse.",par),c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")
  dfAlgos$sens[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
  
  # specificity
  pointEstimate<-gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","psp.",par),"mean"])
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","psp.",par),c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")
  dfAlgos$spec[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
  
  # PPV
  pointEstimate<-gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","ppv.",par),"mean"])
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","ppv.",par),c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")
  dfAlgos$ppv[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
  
  # NPV
  pointEstimate<-gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","npv.",par),"mean"])
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","npv.",par),c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")
  dfAlgos$npv[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
  
  # DYT
  pointEstimate<-gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","dyt.",par),"mean"])
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","dyt.",par),c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")
  dfAlgos$dyt[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
  
  # LR+
  pointEstimate<-gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","lrp.",par),"mean"])
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","lrp.",par),c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")
  dfAlgos$lrp[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
  
  # LR-

  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","lrm.",par),c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")
  dfAlgos$lrm[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
}

dfAlgos$setting<-gsub(pattern="_+",replacement=" ",dfAlgos$setting)

colnames(dfAlgos)<-case_when(
  colnames(dfAlgos)=="setting"~"Country & setting",
  colnames(dfAlgos)=="algo"~"Algorithm code",
  colnames(dfAlgos)=="label"~"Algorithm",
  colnames(dfAlgos)=="prev"~"TB prevalence",

)

dfAlgos %>%

  kable(caption="Facility-based case finding evaluation of individual assays for PHC / lowest levels of primary care settings PLHIV only). Asymptomatics (i.e. those screening negative for W4SS) proportions are estimated directly, using exact binomial confidence intervals, from the data (not modelled). All other parameters are posterior estimates from the Bayesian modelling approach.") %>%

for(j in 1:nrow(dfAlgos)){

  pointEstimate<-gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",res$mcmcSummary["ptb","mean"])

  }

  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","psp.",par),c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")
  dfAlgos$spec[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)

  dfAlgos$ppv[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
  
  # NPV
  pointEstimate<-gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","npv.",par),"mean"])
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","npv.",par),c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")
  dfAlgos$npv[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
  
  # DYT
  pointEstimate<-gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","dyt.",par),"mean"])
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","dyt.",par),c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")
  dfAlgos$dyt[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
  
  # LR+
  pointEstimate<-gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","lrp.",par),"mean"])
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","lrp.",par),c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")

  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","lrm.",par),c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")
  dfAlgos$lrm[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
}

Asymptomatics (i.e. those screening negative for W4SS) proportions are estimated directly, using exact binomial confidence intervals, from the data (not modelled). dt$sensHigh<-as.double(dt$sensHigh)
dt$specEst<-as.double(dt$specEst)
dt$specLow<-as.double(dt$specLow)
dt$specHigh<-as.double(dt$specHigh)

dt$sensCI[dt$sensCI=="NA"]<-""
dt$specCI[dt$specCI=="NA"]<-""

# Set-up theme
tm <- forest_theme(base_size = 10,
                   refline_gp = gpar(lty="blank"),
                   ci_pch = c(15),
                   ci_col = c("steelblue"),
                   footnote_gp = gpar(col = "darkgreen",fontsize=8),
                   vertline_lty = c("dashed", "dashed"),
                   vertline_col = c("darkred","orange"),
                   # Table cell padding, width 4 and heights 3
                   core = list(padding = unit(c(4, 3), "mm")))

p <- forest(dt[,c("Setting","sensCI","Sensitivity","specCI","Specificity")],
            est = list(dt$sensEst,dt$specEst),
            lower = list(dt$sensLow,dt$specLow),
            upper = list(dt$sensHigh,dt$specHigh),
            ci_column = c(3, 5),
            ref_line = 1,
            vert_line = list(c(0.75,0.85),c(0.90,0.95)),
            nudge_y = 0,
            theme = tm,
            xlim=c(0,1),
            footnote="The dashed lines indicate minimum (red) and optimum (orange) thresholds.")

plot(p)

pdf(paste(sep="",outPrefix,"forestPlot_PcfIcfPHC_IndivAssays_",gsub(pattern="-",replacement="",Sys.Date()),".pdf"),width=11,height=10)
plot(p)
dev.off()

for(j in 1:nrow(dfAlgos)){

  pointEstimate<-gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",res$mcmcSummary["ptb","mean"])

  dfAlgos$prev[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
  
  # TB prevalence in asymptomatics
  tmp<-unlist(strsplit(split="_",as.character(dfAlgos$setting[j])))
  if(tmp[1]!="Aggregate"){
    dfTmp<-dfSim %>% filter(country==tmp[1] & region==tmp[2] & setting==tmp[3])
  }else{
    dfTmp<-dfSim %>% filter(setting==tmp[3])
  }
  k<-sum(!dfTmp$w4ss)
  n<-nrow(dfTmp)
  pointEstimate<-round(digits=4,k/n)
  ci<-round(digits=4,binom.test(x=k,n=n)$conf.int)
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",ci)),")")
  dfAlgos$prevAS[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
  
  # sensitivity

  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","psp.",par),c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")

  dfAlgos$npv[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)

  dfAlgos$dyt[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
  
  # LR+

```{r}
#| label: tbl-indivAssays_primAnalPcfIcf_District
#| tbl-cap: "Facility-based case finding evaluation of individual assays: Bayesian posterior estimates for sensitivity, specificity, positive and negative predictive values and positive and negative likelihood ratios for district hospital settings."

outPrefix<-paste(sep="",outDir,"analysisResults_all_")

algoNames<-c("Cxr",
             "Crp",
             "Lam",
             "Poolxpert.Xpert",
             "Xpert"
)

algoLabels<-c("CAD-CXR",
              "CRP",
              "Lam",
              "Pooled Xpert Ultra (incl. single Xpert)",
              "Xpert Ultra"
)

settings<-paste(sep="_",dfResPrimBayes$country,dfResPrimBayes$region,dfResPrimBayes$setting)
settings<-settings[grepl(pattern="District",settings)]
settings<-settings[c(length(settings),1:(length(settings)-1))]

gr<-expand.grid(settings,algoNames)

dfAlgos<-data.frame(
  setting=gr[,1],
  algo=gr[,2],
  label=algoLabels[match(gr[,2],algoNames)],
  prev=NA,
  prevAS=NA,
  sens=NA,
  spec=NA,
  ppv=NA,
  npv=NA,
  dyt=NA,
  lrp=NA,
  lrm=NA
)

for(j in 1:nrow(dfAlgos)){
  res<-allRes[[as.character(dfAlgos$setting[j])]]
  par<-dfAlgos$algo[j]
  
  # TB prevalence
  pointEstimate<-gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",res$mcmcSummary["ptb","mean"])
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary["ptb",c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")
  dfAlgos$prev[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
  
  # TB prevalence in asymptomatics
  tmp<-unlist(strsplit(split="_",as.character(dfAlgos$setting[j])))
  if(tmp[1]!="Aggregate"){
    dfTmp<-dfSim %>% filter(country==tmp[1] & region==tmp[2] & setting==tmp[3])
  }else{
    dfTmp<-dfSim %>% filter(setting==tmp[3])
  }
  k<-sum(!dfTmp$w4ss)
  n<-nrow(dfTmp)
  pointEstimate<-round(digits=4,k/n)
  ci<-round(digits=4,binom.test(x=k,n=n)$conf.int)
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",ci)),")")
  dfAlgos$prevAS[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
  
  # sensitivity
  pointEstimate<-gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","pse.",par),"mean"])
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","pse.",par),c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")
  dfAlgos$sens[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
  
  # specificity
  pointEstimate<-gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","psp.",par),"mean"])
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","psp.",par),c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")
  dfAlgos$spec[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
  
  # PPV
  pointEstimate<-gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","ppv.",par),"mean"])
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","ppv.",par),c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")
  dfAlgos$ppv[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
  
  # NPV
  pointEstimate<-gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","npv.",par),"mean"])
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","npv.",par),c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")
  dfAlgos$npv[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
  
  # DYT
  pointEstimate<-gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","dyt.",par),"mean"])
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","dyt.",par),c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")
  dfAlgos$dyt[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
  
  # LR+
  pointEstimate<-gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","lrp.",par),"mean"])
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","lrp.",par),c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")
  dfAlgos$lrp[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
  
  # LR-
  pointEstimate<-gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","lrm.",par),"mean"])
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","lrm.",par),c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")
  dfAlgos$lrm[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
}

dfAlgos$setting<-gsub(pattern="_+",replacement=" ",dfAlgos$setting)

colnames(dfAlgos)<-case_when(
  colnames(dfAlgos)=="setting"~"Country & setting",
  colnames(dfAlgos)=="algo"~"Algorithm code",
  colnames(dfAlgos)=="label"~"Algorithm",
  colnames(dfAlgos)=="prev"~"TB prevalence",
  colnames(dfAlgos)=="prevAS"~"Asymptomatic TB prevalence",
  colnames(dfAlgos)=="sens"~"Sensitivity",
  colnames(dfAlgos)=="spec"~"Specificity",
  colnames(dfAlgos)=="ppv"~"PPV",
  colnames(dfAlgos)=="npv"~"NPV",
  colnames(dfAlgos)=="dyt"~"DYT",
  colnames(dfAlgos)=="dyd"~"DYD",
  colnames(dfAlgos)=="lrp"~"Positive LR",
  colnames(dfAlgos)=="lrm"~"Negative LR"
)

dfAlgos %>%
  dplyr::select(!contains("code") & !contains("DYD") & !contains("Algorithm")) %>%
  kable(caption="Facility-based case finding evaluation of individual assays for district-level care settings (all participants). Asymptomatics (i.e. those screening negative for W4SS) proportions are estimated directly, using exact binomial confidence intervals, from the data (not modelled). All other parameters are posterior estimates from the Bayesian modelling approach.") %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling(full_width = FALSE) %>%
  kableExtra::group_rows(index=table(fct_inorder(dfAlgos$Algorithm)),label_row_css = "text-align: left")

#### Stratification by HIV status

Please note that only country-settings that included at least 50 individuals are included as inference otherwise difficult due to extremely low or even zero sample sizes for some parameters such as sensitivity.

**PLHIV only**

```{r}
#| label: tbl-primAnalHIVPcfIcf_District

algoNames<-c("Poolxpert.Xpert",

Asymptomatics (i.e. those screening negative for W4SS) proportions are estimated directly, using exact binomial confidence intervals, from the data (not modelled).             lower = list(dt$sensLow,dt$specLow),
            upper = list(dt$sensHigh,dt$specHigh),
            ci_column = c(3, 5),
            ref_line = 1,

pdf(paste(sep="",outPrefix,"forestPlot_PcfIcfDistrict_",gsub(pattern="-",replacement="",Sys.Date()),".pdf"),width=11,height=23)

dt$specCI[dt$specCI=="NA"]<-""

                   ci_col = c("steelblue"),

                   vertline_col = c("darkred","orange"),
                   # Table cell padding, width 4 and heights 3
                   core = list(padding = unit(c(4, 3), "mm")))

p <- forest(dt[,c("Setting","sensCI","Sensitivity","specCI","Specificity")],
            est = list(dt$sensEst,dt$specEst),
            lower = list(dt$sensLow,dt$specLow),
            upper = list(dt$sensHigh,dt$specHigh),
            ci_column = c(3, 5),
            ref_line = 1,
            vert_line = list(c(0.75,0.85),c(0.90,0.95)),
            nudge_y = 0,
            theme = tm,
            xlim=c(0,1),
            footnote="The dashed lines indicate minimum (red) and optimum (orange) thresholds.")

plot(p)

pdf(paste(sep="",outPrefix,"forestPlot_PcfIcfDistrict_IndivAssays_",gsub(pattern="-",replacement="",Sys.Date()),".pdf"),width=11,height=10)

dev.off()

for(j in 1:nrow(dfAlgos)){

  # TB prevalence
  pointEstimate<-gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",res$mcmcSummary["ptb","mean"])
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary["ptb",c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")
  dfAlgos$prev[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
  
  # TB prevalence in asymptomatics
  tmp<-unlist(strsplit(split="_",as.character(dfAlgos$setting[j])))

    dfTmp<-dfSim %>% filter(country==tmp[1] & region==tmp[2] & setting==tmp[3])
  }else{
    dfTmp<-dfSim %>% filter(setting==tmp[3])
  }
  k<-sum(!dfTmp$w4ss)
  n<-nrow(dfTmp)
  pointEstimate<-round(digits=4,k/n)
  ci<-round(digits=4,binom.test(x=k,n=n)$conf.int)
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",ci)),")")
  dfAlgos$prevAS[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
  
  # sensitivity

  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","npv.",par),c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")
  dfAlgos$npv[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
  
  # DYT
  pointEstimate<-gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","dyt.",par),"mean"])
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","dyt.",par),c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")
  dfAlgos$dyt[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
  
  # LR+
  pointEstimate<-gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","lrp.",par),"mean"])
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","lrp.",par),c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")

  # LR-

  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","lrm.",par),c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")
  dfAlgos$lrm[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
}

```{r}
#| label: tbl-indivAssays_primAnalHIVnoPcfIcf_District
#| tbl-cap: "Facility-based case finding evaluation of individual assays (participants without HIV or with unknown HIV status): Bayesian posterior estimates for sensitivity, specificity, positive and negative predictive values and positive and negative likelihood ratios for district hospital settings."

outPrefix<-paste(sep="",outDir,"analysisResults_PLWithoutOrUnknownHIV_")

algoNames<-c("Cxr",
             "Crp",
             "Lam",
             "Poolxpert.Xpert",
             "Xpert"
)

algoLabels<-c("CAD-CXR",
              "CRP",
              "Lam",
              "Pooled Xpert Ultra (incl. single Xpert)",
              "Xpert Ultra"
)

settings<-paste(sep="_",dfResPrimBayesHIVno$country,dfResPrimBayesHIVno$region,dfResPrimBayesHIVno$setting)
settings<-settings[grepl(pattern="District",settings)]
settings<-settings[c(length(settings),1:(length(settings)-1))]

gr<-expand.grid(settings,algoNames)

dfAlgos<-data.frame(
  setting=gr[,1],
  algo=gr[,2],
  label=algoLabels[match(gr[,2],algoNames)],
  prev=NA,
  prevAS=NA,
  sens=NA,
  spec=NA,
  ppv=NA,
  npv=NA,
  dyt=NA,
  lrp=NA,
  lrm=NA
)

for(j in 1:nrow(dfAlgos)){
  res<-allResHIVno[[as.character(dfAlgos$setting[j])]]
  par<-dfAlgos$algo[j]
  
  # TB prevalence
  pointEstimate<-gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",res$mcmcSummary["ptb","mean"])
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary["ptb",c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")
  dfAlgos$prev[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
  
  # TB prevalence in asymptomatics
  tmp<-unlist(strsplit(split="_",as.character(dfAlgos$setting[j])))
  if(tmp[1]!="Aggregate"){
    dfTmp<-dfSim %>% filter(country==tmp[1] & region==tmp[2] & setting==tmp[3])
  }else{
    dfTmp<-dfSim %>% filter(setting==tmp[3])
  }
  k<-sum(!dfTmp$w4ss)
  n<-nrow(dfTmp)
  pointEstimate<-round(digits=4,k/n)
  ci<-round(digits=4,binom.test(x=k,n=n)$conf.int)
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",ci)),")")
  dfAlgos$prevAS[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
  
  # sensitivity
  pointEstimate<-gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","pse.",par),"mean"])
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","pse.",par),c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")
  dfAlgos$sens[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
  
  # specificity
  pointEstimate<-gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","psp.",par),"mean"])
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","psp.",par),c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")
  dfAlgos$spec[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
  
  # PPV
  pointEstimate<-gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","ppv.",par),"mean"])
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","ppv.",par),c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")
  dfAlgos$ppv[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
  
  # NPV
  pointEstimate<-gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","npv.",par),"mean"])
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","npv.",par),c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")
  dfAlgos$npv[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
  
  # DYT
  pointEstimate<-gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","dyt.",par),"mean"])
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","dyt.",par),c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")
  dfAlgos$dyt[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
  
  # LR+
  pointEstimate<-gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","lrp.",par),"mean"])
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","lrp.",par),c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")
  dfAlgos$lrp[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
  
  # LR-
  pointEstimate<-gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","lrm.",par),"mean"])
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","lrm.",par),c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")
  dfAlgos$lrm[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
}

dfAlgos$setting<-gsub(pattern="_+",replacement=" ",dfAlgos$setting)

colnames(dfAlgos)<-case_when(
  colnames(dfAlgos)=="setting"~"Country & setting",
  colnames(dfAlgos)=="algo"~"Algorithm code",
  colnames(dfAlgos)=="label"~"Algorithm",
  colnames(dfAlgos)=="prev"~"TB prevalence",
  colnames(dfAlgos)=="prevAS"~"Asymptomatic TB prevalence",
  colnames(dfAlgos)=="sens"~"Sensitivity",
  colnames(dfAlgos)=="spec"~"Specificity",
  colnames(dfAlgos)=="ppv"~"PPV",
  colnames(dfAlgos)=="npv"~"NPV",
  colnames(dfAlgos)=="dyt"~"DYT",
  colnames(dfAlgos)=="dyd"~"DYD",
  colnames(dfAlgos)=="lrp"~"Positive LR",
  colnames(dfAlgos)=="lrm"~"Negative LR"
)

dfAlgos %>%
  dplyr::select(!contains("code") & !contains("DYD") & !contains("Algorithm")) %>%
  kable(caption="Facility-based case finding evaluation of individual assays for district-level care settings (participants without HIV or with unknown HIV status). Asymptomatics (i.e. those screening negative for W4SS) proportions are estimated directly, using exact binomial confidence intervals, from the data (not modelled). All other parameters are posterior estimates from the Bayesian modelling approach.") %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling(full_width = FALSE) %>%
  kableExtra::group_rows(index=table(fct_inorder(dfAlgos$Algorithm)),label_row_css = "text-align: left")

    dfTmp<-dfSim %>% filter(country==tmp[1] & region==tmp[2] & setting==tmp[3])
  }else{
    dfTmp<-dfSim %>% filter(setting==tmp[3])
  }
  k<-sum(!dfTmp$w4ss)
  n<-nrow(dfTmp)
  pointEstimate<-round(digits=4,k/n)
  ci<-round(digits=4,binom.test(x=k,n=n)$conf.int)
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",ci)),")")
  dfAlgos$prevAS[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
  
  # sensitivity
  pointEstimate<-gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","pse.",par),"mean"])
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","pse.",par),c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")
  dfAlgos$sens[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
  
  # specificity
  pointEstimate<-gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","psp.",par),"mean"])
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","psp.",par),c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")
  dfAlgos$spec[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
  
  # PPV
  pointEstimate<-gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","ppv.",par),"mean"])
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","ppv.",par),c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")
  dfAlgos$ppv[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
  
  # NPV
  pointEstimate<-gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","npv.",par),"mean"])
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","npv.",par),c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")
  dfAlgos$npv[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
  
  # DYT
  pointEstimate<-gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","dyt.",par),"mean"])
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","dyt.",par),c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")
  dfAlgos$dyt[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
  
  # LR+
  pointEstimate<-gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","lrp.",par),"mean"])
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","lrp.",par),c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")
  dfAlgos$lrp[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
  
  # LR-
  pointEstimate<-gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","lrm.",par),"mean"])
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","lrm.",par),c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")
  dfAlgos$lrm[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
}

dfAlgos$setting<-gsub(pattern="_+",replacement=" ",dfAlgos$setting)

colnames(dfAlgos)<-case_when(

  }else{
    dt<-rbind(dt,c(uniqueAlgos[i],rep("",10)))
  }

               dfAlgosTmp$specTxt,dfAlgosTmp$specMedian,dfAlgosTmp$specLow,dfAlgosTmp$specUpp,paste(rep(" ", 20), collapse = " "))
  colnames(dtTmp)<-c("Setting","sensCI","sensEst","sensLow","sensHigh","Sensitivity","specCI","specEst","specLow","specHigh","Specificity")

  rm(dtTmp,dfAlgosTmp)

dt<-as.data.frame(dt)
dt$sensEst<-as.double(dt$sensEst)
dt$sensLow<-as.double(dt$sensLow)
dt$sensHigh<-as.double(dt$sensHigh)
dt$specEst<-as.double(dt$specEst)
dt$specLow<-as.double(dt$specLow)
dt$specHigh<-as.double(dt$specHigh)

dt$sensCI[dt$sensCI=="NA"]<-""
dt$specCI[dt$specCI=="NA"]<-""

# Set-up theme
tm <- forest_theme(base_size = 10,
                   refline_gp = gpar(lty="blank"),
                   ci_pch = c(15),
                   ci_col = c("steelblue"),
                   footnote_gp = gpar(col = "darkgreen",fontsize=8),
                   vertline_lty = c("dashed", "dashed"),
                   vertline_col = c("darkred","orange"),
                   # Table cell padding, width 4 and heights 3
                   core = list(padding = unit(c(4, 3), "mm")))

p <- forest(dt[,c("Setting","sensCI","Sensitivity","specCI","Specificity")],
            est = list(dt$sensEst,dt$specEst),
            lower = list(dt$sensLow,dt$specLow),
            upper = list(dt$sensHigh,dt$specHigh),
            ci_column = c(3, 5),
            ref_line = 1,
            vert_line = list(c(0.75,0.85),c(0.90,0.95)),
            nudge_y = 0,
            theme = tm,
            xlim=c(0,1),
            footnote="The dashed lines indicate minimum (red) and optimum (orange) thresholds.")

plot(p)

pdf(paste(sep="",outPrefix,"forestPlot_AcfW4ss_",gsub(pattern="-",replacement="",Sys.Date()),".pdf"),width=11,height=27)
plot(p)
dev.off()

dt$specLow<-as.double(dt$specLow)
dt$specHigh<-as.double(dt$specHigh)

dt$specCI[dt$specCI=="NA"]<-""

                   refline_gp = gpar(lty="blank"),
                   ci_pch = c(15),
                   ci_col = c("steelblue"),
                   footnote_gp = gpar(col = "darkgreen",fontsize=8),
                   vertline_lty = c("dashed", "dashed"),
                   vertline_col = c("darkred","orange"),
                   # Table cell padding, width 4 and heights 3
                   core = list(padding = unit(c(4, 3), "mm")))

p <- forest(dt[,c("Setting","sensCI","Sensitivity","specCI","Specificity")],
            est = list(dt$sensEst,dt$specEst),
            lower = list(dt$sensLow,dt$specLow),
            upper = list(dt$sensHigh,dt$specHigh),
            ci_column = c(3, 5),
            ref_line = 1,
            vert_line = list(c(0.75,0.85),c(0.90,0.95)),
            nudge_y = 0,
            theme = tm,
            xlim=c(0,1),
            footnote="The dashed lines indicate minimum (red) and optimum (orange) thresholds.")

plot(p)

pdf(paste(sep="",outPrefix,"forestPlot_AcfW4ss_IndivAssays",gsub(pattern="-",replacement="",Sys.Date()),".pdf"),width=11,height=10)
plot(p)
dev.off()

  dfAlgosTmp<-dfAlgos %>% dplyr::filter(label==uniqueAlgos[i])
  dtTmp<-cbind(gsub(paste(sep="","   ",dfAlgosTmp$setting),pattern="_+",replacement=" "),
               dfAlgosTmp$sensTxt,dfAlgosTmp$sensMedian,dfAlgosTmp$sensLow,dfAlgosTmp$sensUpp,paste(rep(" ", 20), collapse = " "),
               dfAlgosTmp$specTxt,dfAlgosTmp$specMedian,dfAlgosTmp$specLow,dfAlgosTmp$specUpp,paste(rep(" ", 20), collapse = " "))
  colnames(dtTmp)<-c("Setting","sensCI","sensEst","sensLow","sensHigh","Sensitivity","specCI","specEst","specLow","specHigh","Specificity")
  dt<-rbind(dt,dtTmp)
  rm(dtTmp,dfAlgosTmp)
}

dt$specLow<-as.double(dt$specLow)
dt$specHigh<-as.double(dt$specHigh)

dt$sensCI[dt$sensCI=="NA"]<-""
dt$specCI[dt$specCI=="NA"]<-""

# Set-up theme
tm <- forest_theme(base_size = 10,
                   refline_gp = gpar(lty="blank"),
                   ci_pch = c(15),
                   ci_col = c("steelblue"),
                   footnote_gp = gpar(col = "darkgreen",fontsize=8),
                   vertline_lty = c("dashed", "dashed"),
                   vertline_col = c("darkred","orange"),
                   # Table cell padding, width 4 and heights 3
                   core = list(padding = unit(c(4, 3), "mm")))

p <- forest(dt[,c("Setting","sensCI","Sensitivity","specCI","Specificity")],
            est = list(dt$sensEst,dt$specEst),
            lower = list(dt$sensLow,dt$specLow),
            upper = list(dt$sensHigh,dt$specHigh),
            ci_column = c(3, 5),
            ref_line = 1,
            vert_line = list(c(0.75,0.85),c(0.90,0.95)),
            nudge_y = 0,
            theme = tm,
            xlim=c(0,1),
            footnote="The dashed lines indicate minimum (red) and optimum (orange) thresholds.")

plot(p)

pdf(paste(sep="",outPrefix,"forestPlot_AcfW4ss_",gsub(pattern="-",replacement="",Sys.Date()),".pdf"),width=11,height=27)
plot(p)
dev.off()

  # sensitivity

  # LR+

dt$specCI[dt$specCI=="NA"]<-""

```{r}
#| label: tbl-primAnalAcf-cxr
#| tbl-cap: "Community-based case finding evaluation of algorithms (all participants; CAD-CXR entry): Bayesian posterior estimates for sensitivity, specificity, positive and negative predictive values and positive and negative likelihood ratios for different settings."

outPrefix<-paste(sep="",outDir,"analysisResults_all_")

algoNames<-c("Poolxpert.Xpert",
             "Xpert",
             "Lam",
             "Crp.Poolxpert.Xpert",
             "Lam.Poolxpert.Xpert",
             "CrpLam.Poolxpert.Xpert",
             "Crp.Xpert",
             "Lam.Xpert",
             "CrpLam.Xpert",
             "Crp.Lam"
)

algoLabels<-c("Pooled Xpert Ultra --> Xpert Ultra",
             "Xpert Ultra",
             "LAM",
             "CRP --> Pooled Xpert Ultra --> Xpert Ultra",
             "LAM --> Pooled Xpert Ultra --> Xpert Ultra",
             "CRP | LAM --> Pooled Xpert Ultra --> Xpert Ultra",
             "CRP --> Xpert Ultra",
             "LAM --> Xpert Ultra",
             "CRP | LAM --> Xpert Ultra",
             "CRP --> LAM"
)

settings<-paste(sep="_",dfResPrimBayes$country,dfResPrimBayes$region,dfResPrimBayes$setting,gsub(pattern=" \\| ",replacement="",dfResPrimBayes$entryToStudy))
settings<-settings[dfResPrimBayes$entryToStudy=="CXR"]

gr<-expand.grid(settings,algoNames)

dfAlgos<-data.frame(
  setting=gr[,1],
  algo=gr[,2],
  label=algoLabels[match(gr[,2],algoNames)],
  prev=NA,
  prevAS=NA,
  sens=NA,
  spec=NA,
  ppv=NA,
  npv=NA,
  dyt=NA,
  lrp=NA,
  lrm=NA
)

for(j in 1:nrow(dfAlgos)){
  res<-allRes[[as.character(dfAlgos$setting[j])]]
  par<-dfAlgos$algo[j]
  
  # TB prevalence
  pointEstimate<-gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",res$mcmcSummary["ptb","mean"])
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary["ptb",c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")
  dfAlgos$prev[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
  
  # TB prevalence in asymptomatics
  tmp<-unlist(strsplit(split="_",as.character(dfAlgos$setting[j])))
  if(tmp[1]!="Aggregate"){
    dfTmp<-dfSim %>% filter(country==tmp[1] & region==tmp[2] & setting==tmp[3])
  }else{
    dfTmp<-dfSim %>% filter(setting==tmp[3])
  }
  k<-sum(!dfTmp$w4ss)
  n<-nrow(dfTmp)
  pointEstimate<-round(digits=4,k/n)
  ci<-round(digits=4,binom.test(x=k,n=n)$conf.int)
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",ci)),")")
  dfAlgos$prevAS[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
  
  # sensitivity
  pointEstimate<-gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","pse.",par),"mean"])
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","pse.",par),c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")
  dfAlgos$sens[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
  
  # specificity
  pointEstimate<-gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","psp.",par),"mean"])
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","psp.",par),c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")
  dfAlgos$spec[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
  
  # PPV
  pointEstimate<-gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","ppv.",par),"mean"])
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","ppv.",par),c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")
  dfAlgos$ppv[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
  
  # NPV
  pointEstimate<-gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","npv.",par),"mean"])
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","npv.",par),c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")
  dfAlgos$npv[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
  
  # DYT
  pointEstimate<-gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","dyt.",par),"mean"])
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","dyt.",par),c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")
  dfAlgos$dyt[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
  
  # LR+
  pointEstimate<-gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","lrp.",par),"mean"])
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","lrp.",par),c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")
  dfAlgos$lrp[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
  
  # LR-
  pointEstimate<-gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","lrm.",par),"mean"])
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","lrm.",par),c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")
  dfAlgos$lrm[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
}

dfAlgos$setting<-gsub(pattern="_+",replacement=" ",dfAlgos$setting)

colnames(dfAlgos)<-case_when(
  colnames(dfAlgos)=="setting"~"Country & setting",
  colnames(dfAlgos)=="algo"~"Algorithm code",
  colnames(dfAlgos)=="label"~"Algorithm",
  colnames(dfAlgos)=="prev"~"TB prevalence",
  colnames(dfAlgos)=="prevAS"~"Asymptomatic TB prevalence",
  colnames(dfAlgos)=="sens"~"Sensitivity",
  colnames(dfAlgos)=="spec"~"Specificity",
  colnames(dfAlgos)=="ppv"~"PPV",
  colnames(dfAlgos)=="npv"~"NPV",
  colnames(dfAlgos)=="dyt"~"DYT",
  colnames(dfAlgos)=="dyd"~"DYD",
  colnames(dfAlgos)=="lrp"~"Positive LR",
  colnames(dfAlgos)=="lrm"~"Negative LR"
)

dfAlgos %>%
  dplyr::select(!contains("code") & !contains("Algorithm")) %>%
  kable(caption="Community-based case finding evaluation of algorithms (all participants; CAD-CXR entry to study). Asymptomatics (i.e. those screening negative for W4SS) proportions are estimated directly, using exact binomial confidence intervals, from the data (not modelled). All other parameters are posterior estimates from the Bayesian modelling approach.") %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling(full_width = FALSE) %>%
  kableExtra::group_rows(index=table(fct_inorder(dfAlgos$Algorithm)),label_row_css = "text-align: left")

  par<-dfAlgos$algo[j]
  
  # TB prevalence
  pointEstimate<-gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",res$mcmcSummary["ptb","mean"])
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary["ptb",c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")
  dfAlgos$prev[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
  
  # TB prevalence in asymptomatics
  tmp<-unlist(strsplit(split="_",as.character(dfAlgos$setting[j])))
  if(tmp[1]!="Aggregate"){
    dfTmp<-dfSim %>% filter(country==tmp[1] & region==tmp[2] & setting==tmp[3])
  }else{
    dfTmp<-dfSim %>% filter(setting==tmp[3])
  }
  k<-sum(!dfTmp$w4ss)
  n<-nrow(dfTmp)
  pointEstimate<-round(digits=4,k/n)
  ci<-round(digits=4,binom.test(x=k,n=n)$conf.int)
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",ci)),")")
  dfAlgos$prevAS[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
  
  # sensitivity
  pointEstimate<-gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","pse.",par),"mean"])
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","pse.",par),c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")
  dfAlgos$sens[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
  
  # specificity
  pointEstimate<-gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","psp.",par),"mean"])
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","psp.",par),c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")
  dfAlgos$spec[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
  
  # PPV
  pointEstimate<-gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","ppv.",par),"mean"])
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","ppv.",par),c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")
  dfAlgos$ppv[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
  
  # NPV
  pointEstimate<-gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","npv.",par),"mean"])
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","npv.",par),c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")
  dfAlgos$npv[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
  
  # DYT
  pointEstimate<-gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","dyt.",par),"mean"])
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","dyt.",par),c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")
  dfAlgos$dyt[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
  
  # LR+
  pointEstimate<-gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","lrp.",par),"mean"])
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","lrp.",par),c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")
  dfAlgos$lrp[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
  
  # LR-
  pointEstimate<-gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","lrm.",par),"mean"])
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","lrm.",par),c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")
  dfAlgos$lrm[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
}

  colnames(dfAlgos)=="dyd"~"DYD",
  colnames(dfAlgos)=="lrp"~"Positive LR",
  colnames(dfAlgos)=="lrm"~"Negative LR"
)

Asymptomatics (i.e. those screening negative for W4SS) proportions are estimated directly, using exact binomial confidence intervals, from the data (not modelled). All other parameters are posterior estimates from the Bayesian modelling approach.") %>%

  kableExtra::group_rows(index=table(fct_inorder(dfAlgos$Algorithm)),label_row_css = "text-align: left")

    names(dt)<-c("Setting","sensCI","sensEst","sensLow","sensHigh","Sensitivity","specCI","specEst","specLow","specHigh","Specificity")
  }else{
    dt<-rbind(dt,c(uniqueAlgos[i],rep("",10)))
  }
  dfAlgosTmp<-dfAlgos %>% dplyr::filter(label==uniqueAlgos[i])
  dtTmp<-cbind(gsub(paste(sep="","   ",dfAlgosTmp$setting),pattern="_+",replacement=" "),
               dfAlgosTmp$sensTxt,dfAlgosTmp$sensMedian,dfAlgosTmp$sensLow,dfAlgosTmp$sensUpp,paste(rep(" ", 20), collapse = " "),
               dfAlgosTmp$specTxt,dfAlgosTmp$specMedian,dfAlgosTmp$specLow,dfAlgosTmp$specUpp,paste(rep(" ", 20), collapse = " "))
  colnames(dtTmp)<-c("Setting","sensCI","sensEst","sensLow","sensHigh","Sensitivity","specCI","specEst","specLow","specHigh","Specificity")
  dt<-rbind(dt,dtTmp)
  rm(dtTmp,dfAlgosTmp)
}

dt<-as.data.frame(dt)
dt$sensEst<-as.double(dt$sensEst)
dt$sensLow<-as.double(dt$sensLow)
dt$sensHigh<-as.double(dt$sensHigh)
dt$specEst<-as.double(dt$specEst)
dt$specLow<-as.double(dt$specLow)
dt$specHigh<-as.double(dt$specHigh)

dt$sensCI[dt$sensCI=="NA"]<-""
dt$specCI[dt$specCI=="NA"]<-""

# Set-up theme
tm <- forest_theme(base_size = 10,
                   refline_gp = gpar(lty="blank"),
                   ci_pch = c(15),
                   ci_col = c("steelblue"),
                   footnote_gp = gpar(col = "darkgreen",fontsize=8),
                   vertline_lty = c("dashed", "dashed"),
                   vertline_col = c("darkred","orange"),
                   # Table cell padding, width 4 and heights 3
                   core = list(padding = unit(c(4, 3), "mm")))

p <- forest(dt[,c("Setting","sensCI","Sensitivity","specCI","Specificity")],
            est = list(dt$sensEst,dt$specEst),
            lower = list(dt$sensLow,dt$specLow),
            upper = list(dt$sensHigh,dt$specHigh),
            ci_column = c(3, 5),
            ref_line = 1,
            vert_line = list(c(0.75,0.85),c(0.90,0.95)),
            nudge_y = 0,
            theme = tm,
            xlim=c(0,1),
            footnote="The dashed lines indicate minimum (red) and optimum (orange) thresholds.")

plot(p)

pdf(paste(sep="",outPrefix,"forestPlot_AcfCxr_IndivAssays_",gsub(pattern="-",replacement="",Sys.Date()),".pdf"),width=11,height=10)
plot(p)
dev.off()

dt$specCI[dt$specCI=="NA"]<-""

```{r}
#| label: tbl-indivAssays_primAnalHIVAcf-cxr
#| tbl-cap: "Community-based case finding evaluation of individual assays (participants with HIV; CAD-CXR entry): Bayesian posterior estimates for sensitivity, specificity, positive and negative predictive values and positive and negative likelihood ratios for different settings."

outPrefix<-paste(sep="",outDir,"analysisResults_PLHIV_")

gr<-expand.grid(settings,algoNames)

dfAlgos<-data.frame(
  setting=gr[,1],
  algo=gr[,2],
  label=algoLabels[match(gr[,2],algoNames)],
  prev=NA,
  prevAS=NA,
  sens=NA,
  spec=NA,
  ppv=NA,
  npv=NA,
  dyt=NA,
  lrp=NA,
  lrm=NA
)

for(j in 1:nrow(dfAlgos)){
  res<-allResHIV[[as.character(dfAlgos$setting[j])]]
  par<-dfAlgos$algo[j]
  
  # TB prevalence
  pointEstimate<-gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",res$mcmcSummary["ptb","mean"])
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary["ptb",c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")
  dfAlgos$prev[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
  
  # TB prevalence in asymptomatics
  tmp<-unlist(strsplit(split="_",as.character(dfAlgos$setting[j])))
  if(tmp[1]!="Aggregate"){
    dfTmp<-dfSim %>% filter(country==tmp[1] & region==tmp[2] & setting==tmp[3])
  }else{
    dfTmp<-dfSim %>% filter(setting==tmp[3])
  }
  k<-sum(!dfTmp$w4ss)
  n<-nrow(dfTmp)
  pointEstimate<-round(digits=4,k/n)
  ci<-round(digits=4,binom.test(x=k,n=n)$conf.int)
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",ci)),")")
  dfAlgos$prevAS[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
  
  # sensitivity
  pointEstimate<-gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","pse.",par),"mean"])
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","pse.",par),c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")
  dfAlgos$sens[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)

  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","psp.",par),c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")
  dfAlgos$spec[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
  
  # PPV
  pointEstimate<-gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","ppv.",par),"mean"])
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","ppv.",par),c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")
  dfAlgos$ppv[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)

  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","npv.",par),c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")
  dfAlgos$npv[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
  
  # DYT
  pointEstimate<-gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","dyt.",par),"mean"])
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","dyt.",par),c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")
  dfAlgos$dyt[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
  
  # LR+
  pointEstimate<-gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","lrp.",par),"mean"])
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","lrp.",par),c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")
  dfAlgos$lrp[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
  
  # LR-

  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","lrm.",par),c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")
  dfAlgos$lrm[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
}

dfAlgos$setting<-gsub(pattern="_+",replacement=" ",dfAlgos$setting)

colnames(dfAlgos)<-case_when(
  colnames(dfAlgos)=="setting"~"Country & setting",
  colnames(dfAlgos)=="algo"~"Algorithm code",
  colnames(dfAlgos)=="label"~"Algorithm",
  colnames(dfAlgos)=="prev"~"TB prevalence",
  colnames(dfAlgos)=="prevAS"~"Asymptomatic TB prevalence",

  colnames(dfAlgos)=="lrm"~"Negative LR"
)

dfAlgos %>%
  dplyr::select(!contains("code") & !contains("Algorithm")) %>%
  kable(caption="Community-based case finding evaluation of individual assays (PLHIV only; CAD-CXR entry to study). Asymptomatics (i.e. those screening negative for W4SS) proportions are estimated directly, using exact binomial confidence intervals, from the data (not modelled). All other parameters are posterior estimates from the Bayesian modelling approach.") %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling(full_width = FALSE) %>%
  kableExtra::group_rows(index=table(fct_inorder(dfAlgos$Algorithm)),label_row_css = "text-align: left")

```{r}
#| label: tbl-primAnalAcf-w4sscxr
#| tbl-cap: "Community-based case finding evaluation of algorithms (all participants; W4SS or CAD-CXR entry): Bayesian posterior estimates for sensitivity, specificity, positive and negative predictive values and positive and negative likelihood ratios for different settings."

outPrefix<-paste(sep="",outDir,"analysisResults_all_")

gr<-expand.grid(settings,algoNames)

  setting=gr[,1],

  prev=NA,
  prevAS=NA,
  sens=NA,
  spec=NA,
  ppv=NA,
  npv=NA,
  dyt=NA,
  lrp=NA,
  lrm=NA
)

for(j in 1:nrow(dfAlgos)){
  res<-allRes[[as.character(dfAlgos$setting[j])]]
  par<-dfAlgos$algo[j]
  
  # TB prevalence
  pointEstimate<-gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",res$mcmcSummary["ptb","mean"])
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary["ptb",c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")
  dfAlgos$prev[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)

  }else{
    dfTmp<-dfSim %>% filter(setting==tmp[3])
  }
  k<-sum(!dfTmp$w4ss)
  n<-nrow(dfTmp)
  pointEstimate<-round(digits=4,k/n)
  ci<-round(digits=4,binom.test(x=k,n=n)$conf.int)
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",ci)),")")
  dfAlgos$prevAS[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
  
  # sensitivity

  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","psp.",par),c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")

  dfAlgos$dyt[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
  
  # LR+
  pointEstimate<-gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","lrp.",par),"mean"])
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","lrp.",par),c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")

  # LR-

  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","lrm.",par),c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")

```{r}

  npv=NA,

)

for(j in 1:nrow(dfAlgos)){
  res<-allRes[[as.character(dfAlgos$setting[j])]]
  par<-dfAlgos$algo[j]
  
  # TB prevalence
  pointEstimate<-gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",res$mcmcSummary["ptb","mean"])
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary["ptb",c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")

  tmp<-unlist(strsplit(split="_",as.character(dfAlgos$setting[j])))

  }
  k<-sum(!dfTmp$w4ss)
  n<-nrow(dfTmp)

  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",ci)),")")
  dfAlgos$prevAS[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
  
  # sensitivity
  pointEstimate<-gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","pse.",par),"mean"])
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","pse.",par),c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")
  dfAlgos$sens[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)

  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","psp.",par),c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")
  dfAlgos$spec[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
  
  # PPV
  pointEstimate<-gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","ppv.",par),"mean"])
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","ppv.",par),c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")
  dfAlgos$ppv[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
  
  # NPV
  pointEstimate<-gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","npv.",par),"mean"])
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","npv.",par),c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")
  dfAlgos$npv[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
  
  # DYT

  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","dyt.",par),c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")
  dfAlgos$dyt[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
  
  # LR+
  pointEstimate<-gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","lrp.",par),"mean"])

  dfAlgos$lrm[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
}

dfAlgos$setting<-gsub(pattern="_+",replacement=" ",dfAlgos$setting)

colnames(dfAlgos)<-case_when(
  colnames(dfAlgos)=="setting"~"Country & setting",
  colnames(dfAlgos)=="algo"~"Algorithm code",
  colnames(dfAlgos)=="label"~"Algorithm",

)

dfAlgos %>%

Asymptomatics (i.e. those screening negative for W4SS) proportions are estimated directly, using exact binomial confidence intervals, from the data (not modelled). All other parameters are posterior estimates from the Bayesian modelling approach.") %>%

            est = list(dt$sensEst,dt$specEst),
            lower = list(dt$sensLow,dt$specLow),
            upper = list(dt$sensHigh,dt$specHigh),
            ci_column = c(3, 5),
            ref_line = 1,
            vert_line = list(c(0.75,0.85),c(0.90,0.95)),
            nudge_y = 0,

            xlim=c(0,1),

```{r}
#| label: tbl-indivAssays_primAnalHIVAcf-w4sscxr
#| tbl-cap: "Community-based case finding evaluation of individual assays (PLHIV only; W4SS or CAD-CXR entry): Bayesian posterior estimates for sensitivity, specificity, positive and negative predictive values and positive and negative likelihood ratios for different settings."

outPrefix<-paste(sep="",outDir,"analysisResults_PLHIV_")

algoNames<-c("Cxr",
             "Crp",
             "Lam",
             "Poolxpert.Xpert",
             "Xpert"
)

algoLabels<-c("CAD-CXR",
              "CRP",
              "Lam",
              "Pooled Xpert Ultra (incl. single Xpert)",
              "Xpert Ultra"
)

settings<-paste(sep="_",dfResPrimBayesHIV$country,dfResPrimBayesHIV$region,dfResPrimBayesHIV$setting,gsub(pattern=" \\| ",replacement="",dfResPrimBayesHIV$entryToStudy))
settings<-settings[gsub(pattern=" \\| ",replacement="",dfResPrimBayesHIV$entryToStudy)=="W4SSCXR"]

gr<-expand.grid(settings,algoNames)

dfAlgos<-data.frame(
  setting=gr[,1],
  algo=gr[,2],
  label=algoLabels[match(gr[,2],algoNames)],
  prev=NA,
  prevAS=NA,
  sens=NA,
  spec=NA,
  ppv=NA,
  npv=NA,
  dyt=NA,
  lrp=NA,
  lrm=NA
)

for(j in 1:nrow(dfAlgos)){
  res<-allResHIV[[as.character(dfAlgos$setting[j])]]
  par<-dfAlgos$algo[j]
  
  # TB prevalence
  pointEstimate<-gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",res$mcmcSummary["ptb","mean"])
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary["ptb",c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")
  dfAlgos$prev[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
  
  # TB prevalence in asymptomatics
  tmp<-unlist(strsplit(split="_",as.character(dfAlgos$setting[j])))
  if(tmp[1]!="Aggregate"){
    dfTmp<-dfSim %>% filter(country==tmp[1] & region==tmp[2] & setting==tmp[3])
  }else{
    dfTmp<-dfSim %>% filter(setting==tmp[3])
  }
  k<-sum(!dfTmp$w4ss)
  n<-nrow(dfTmp)
  pointEstimate<-round(digits=4,k/n)
  ci<-round(digits=4,binom.test(x=k,n=n)$conf.int)
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",ci)),")")
  dfAlgos$prevAS[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
  
  # sensitivity
  pointEstimate<-gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","pse.",par),"mean"])
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","pse.",par),c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")
  dfAlgos$sens[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
  
  # specificity
  pointEstimate<-gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","psp.",par),"mean"])
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","psp.",par),c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")
  dfAlgos$spec[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
  
  # PPV
  pointEstimate<-gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","ppv.",par),"mean"])
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","ppv.",par),c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")
  dfAlgos$ppv[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
  
  # NPV
  pointEstimate<-gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","npv.",par),"mean"])
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","npv.",par),c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")
  dfAlgos$npv[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
  
  # DYT
  pointEstimate<-gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","dyt.",par),"mean"])
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","dyt.",par),c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")
  dfAlgos$dyt[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
  
  # LR+
  pointEstimate<-gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","lrp.",par),"mean"])
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","lrp.",par),c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")
  dfAlgos$lrp[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
  
  # LR-
  pointEstimate<-gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","lrm.",par),"mean"])
  ci<-paste(sep="","(",gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",paste(collapse=",",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","lrm.",par),c("2.5%","97.5%")])),")")
  dfAlgos$lrm[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
}

dfAlgos$setting<-gsub(pattern="_+",replacement=" ",dfAlgos$setting)

colnames(dfAlgos)<-case_when(
  colnames(dfAlgos)=="setting"~"Country & setting",
  colnames(dfAlgos)=="algo"~"Algorithm code",
  colnames(dfAlgos)=="label"~"Algorithm",
  colnames(dfAlgos)=="prev"~"TB prevalence",
  colnames(dfAlgos)=="prevAS"~"Asymptomatic TB prevalence",
  colnames(dfAlgos)=="sens"~"Sensitivity",
  colnames(dfAlgos)=="spec"~"Specificity",
  colnames(dfAlgos)=="ppv"~"PPV",
  colnames(dfAlgos)=="npv"~"NPV",
  colnames(dfAlgos)=="dyt"~"DYT",
  colnames(dfAlgos)=="dyd"~"DYD",
  colnames(dfAlgos)=="lrp"~"Positive LR",
  colnames(dfAlgos)=="lrm"~"Negative LR"
)

dfAlgos %>%
  dplyr::select(!contains("code") & !contains("Algorithm")) %>%
  kable(caption="Community-based case finding evaluation of individual assays (PLHIV only; CAD-CXR entry to study). Asymptomatics (i.e. those screening negative for W4SS) proportions are estimated directly, using exact binomial confidence intervals, from the data (not modelled). All other parameters are posterior estimates from the Bayesian modelling approach.") %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling(full_width = FALSE) %>%
  kableExtra::group_rows(index=table(fct_inorder(dfAlgos$Algorithm)),label_row_css = "text-align: left")
```

  pointEstimate<-gsub(pattern=" ",replacement="",res$mcmcSummary[paste(sep="","lrm.",par),"mean"])

  dfAlgos$lrm[j]<-paste(sep=" ",pointEstimate,ci)
}

dfAlgos$setting<-gsub(pattern="_+",replacement=" ",dfAlgos$setting)

colnames(dfAlgos)<-case_when(

All other parameters are posterior estimates from the Bayesian modelling approach.") %>%

### Link-up with the health economic analysis

#### Beta distributions for parameters

As mentioned, all of the above are probability parameters and they will directly inform the decision tree model used in the planned health economic analysis. To allow propagating the uncertainty of each of the above estimates, we will need to input the entire posterior distribution for each parameter into the health economic modelling.

The easiest way, for each parameter, to do this is to use quantile matching to identify the best fitting beta distribution for each empirical distribution. We will then use the estimated beta distribution parameters to feed into the health economic modelling.

To illustrate this computation, @tbl-primAnalBayesBeta shows the matrix of the estimated $a,b$ values, obtained for the posterior distribution for the performance estimates of the individual tests (for the example of Cameroon PHC).

  }else{

## Secondary objectives analyses

Secondary objectives will use the results from the primary analyses. At the stage-gating the scientific advisory board will select the relevant combinations to take forward, while the health economic analysis (see separate analysis plan) will deal with the scale-up and cost-effectiveness objective.
